scenes.subtext: That system was cut out in 2011.
scenes.narration: The tannoy paged me by name at four this morning. That system was cut out of this building in twenty eleven.

scenes.narration: I took the panel off underneath it. The wire behind the speaker is cut and capped, and the cap has gone brittle with age.

scenes.subtext: It has no power to be lit by.

scenes.narration: It paged me again four minutes later. The same voice. It did not sound like it was reading.

scenes.subtext: One of them stood under it.
scenes.narration: The other two on nights heard nothing at all. One of them was standing directly underneath it when it happened.

scenes.subtext: It says my name, then it says that.
scenes.narration: Every night since, at four exactly, it says my name. Then it says, do not answer the page.
